newsitem.title: USA: FlowServe replaces Durco on S&P Midcap 400.
newsitem.headline: FlowServe replaces Durco on S&P Midcap 400.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Financial Information Services said Tuesday that Flowserve Corp will replace Durco International Inc in the MidCap 400 Index after the close of trading July 22.
Flowserve is to be formed by the July 22 merger of S&P MidCap 400 component Durco and S&P SmallCap 600 component BW/IP Inc.
Men's Wearhouse Inc will replace BW/IP in the SmallCap 600 Index, S&P said.
Flowserve will be a maker of fluid-handling equipment, including pumps, valves, mechanical seals, and specialty valve actuators.
The Men's Wearhouse, headquartered in Houston, operates a chain of off-price retailers of men's tailored business clothing.
